items.description:
Today, we’re excited to announce that Flawless App has joined Abstract, a design delivery platform that brings visibility, accountability, measurability, and predictability to design.
Flawless App was our first company, and we’re proud of everything that we’ve achieved with our 5-person team.
Since 2015, we’ve launched powerful tools for designers and developers — among them are Flawless App, Reduce, Flawless Feedback. We’ve also invested a lot of love and care into community-driven initiatives. Awesome Design Tools is one of them.
items.title: Awesome Design Tools as a part of Flawless App family joins Abstract!

items.description: Our team has joined Abstract and is focused on building out the Abstract SDK, bringing developers’ experience forward. One unbelievable journey has finished and the new one has just begun. And if you want to know more about the future of Awesome Design Tools, please keep reading our FAQ.
items.title: So what’s next?

items.description: Accessibility is the practice of creating websites and apps usable for all people, including individuals with visual, motor, auditory, speech, or cognitive disabilities. Here you will find web accessibility tools, accessibility testing tools, and accessibility apps both for developers and designers:

items.title: Axe
items.description: accessibility engine designed to work on all modern browsers and with whatever tools, frameworks, libraries, and environments you use today. It's an automated accessibility testing tool for developers.

items.title: ANDI
items.description: accessibility testing tool for web content (bookmarklet). It will automatically detect accessibility issues, give suggestions to improve online accessibility and check 508 compliance.

items.title: Accessible Palette Builder
items.description: an Elm-based prototype to help designers build accessible color palettes.

items.title: A11ygator
items.description: a web tool to analyze websites against WCAG rules. Also available as Google Chrome browser extension and as Twitter bot.

items.title: Accessibility Tools

items.description: If you are looking for an eyedropper tool, color identifier or color capture, check this section. With the color pickers mentioned here, you will be able to create new color combinations and define great ones. Almost all of these tools are free:

items.title: React Color
items.description: a collection of color pickers from Sketch, Photoshop, Chrome. It‘s free and open-source.

items.title: Material Colors Native
items.description: Google's material design color palette in the form of a mac app.

items.title: Color Deck
items.description: an HSL driven color palette collection. It's also open-source.

items.title: Color Picker Tools

items.description: Fonts are commonly used for making the web a more beautiful place. It’s an essential part of any design. In this section, you’ll find fonts generators & font finder tools that allow you to manage and work with fonts:

items.title: Google Webfonts Helper
items.description: a hassle way to self-host Google Fonts. It‘s free and open-source.

items.title: Web Font Preview
items.description: preview Google Font pairings with components and site templates.

items.title: Font Tools

items.description: As well as fonts, icons are used in every design. These basic elements support and guide many user actions inside the product. Without a doubt, icons are a vital element in user navigation. While making those small design elements is hard and time-consuming, you can get thousands of vector icons for personal and commercial use.

items.title: Font Awesome
items.description: the web's most popular icon set and toolkit, also it's open source.

items.title: Fontello
items.description: tool to build custom fonts with icons, also open source.

items.title: Icons Tools

items.description: Pixel art is a digital art form where color is applied to individual pixels to create an image. The pixel art can be used to create everything from intricate scenes and game backgrounds to character designs or emoji. If you feel curious to try, check this pixel art software for both macOS and Windows:

items.title: Data Pixels
items.description: create pixel art programmatically. Includes DataPixels.js and Data Pixels Playground desktop app.

items.title: Make 8 bit art
items.description: an open source and in-browser pixel art drawing tool.

items.title: Pixel Art Tools

items.description: Taking screenshots is a typical task in the design & development workflow. So these free and full-featured screenshot apps can help you capture a screen with ease. Some screen captures are macOS only, while others support both OS:

items.title: Kap
items.description: open source screen recorder with options to export to GIF, MP4, WebM and APNG.

items.title: ScreenToGif
items.description: record a gif of part of the screen. Only available for Windows.

items.title: Screenshot Software

items.description: Awesome Design Tools & Plugins is curated by Lisa Dziuba & Valia Havruliyk from Flawless team. And it was hugely inspired by articles from the design community and Prototypr.io Toolbox made by our good friend Graeme Fulton. If you found some great design tools, please suggest it. Thanks for making this project awesome :)
